title: openagents-cli terminal welcome-card test depends on which coding agents are installed
body: Reported by #10220 and #10296 agents: `openagents-cli` `tests/terminal.rs` welcome-card test passes or fails depending on which coding agents (codex/claude/grok/devin/opencode) are installed on the machine. Isolate the test from the host (fake PATH/HOME with a fixed set of agents) and assert the card for that fixed set; clean on Mac and Linux.
